data.content:
{
 "component": "pagination",
 "file": "kit/pagination.js",
 "about": "Invented result sets. Every sample mounts the same entry with different options; the preview fakes the items of the current page and logs onChange.",
 "note": "No data is saved anywhere; onChange only reports.",
 "samples": [
  {
   "key": "search",
   "label": "Search results",
   "about": "A typical search: 1,234 results, 20 a page, on page 3. Numbers, a range in words, page size and a jump field.",
   "opts": {
    "total": 1234,
    "pageSize": 20,
    "page": 3,
    "pageSizes": [
     10,
     20,
     50,
     100
    ]
   }
  },
  {
   "key": "one",
   "label": "One page",
   "about": "Seven results fit on one page: both arrows are disabled and the only page is the current one.",
   "opts": {
    "total": 7,
    "pageSize": 20,
    "page": 1
   }
  },
  {
   "key": "two",
   "label": "Two pages",
   "about": "31 results in two pages; no truncation, no jump field.",
   "opts": {
    "total": 31,
    "pageSize": 20,
    "page": 1
   }
  },
  {
   "key": "empty",
   "label": "No results",
   "about": "A total of 0: the summary says so and the nav is left out, so there is nothing to tab through.",
   "opts": {
    "total": 0,
    "pageSize": 20,
    "page": 1
   }
  },
  {
   "key": "huge",
   "label": "50,000 pages",
   "about": "pageCount 50,000 on page 25,000 with First and Last and the arrow keys. Every page box is as wide as 50,000, so nothing jumps.",
   "opts": {
    "pageCount": 50000,
    "page": 25000,
    "firstLast": true,
    "keys": true,
    "siblings": 1
   }
  },
  {
   "key": "compact",
   "label": "Compact",
   "about": "'Page 3 of 50' with a page select between the arrows, plus the page size.",
   "opts": {
    "variant": "compact",
    "total": 1234,
    "pageSize": 25,
    "page": 3
   }
  },
  {
   "key": "simple",
   "label": "Simple",
   "about": "Previous and Next only; the summary says where you are.",
   "opts": {
    "variant": "simple",
    "pageCount": 12,
    "page": 3
   }
  },
  {
   "key": "loadmore",
   "label": "Load more",
   "about": "'Load 20 more' with the count left and a polite running count; the list grows instead of paging.",
   "opts": {
    "variant": "load-more",
    "total": 1234,
    "pageSize": 20,
    "page": 2,
    "controls": "pv-pg-items"
   }
  },
  {
   "key": "cursor",
   "label": "Unknown total",
   "about": "A cursor API: no total, only hasNext. 'Page 4' between the arrows; the preview reports hasNext false on page 6.",
   "opts": {
    "total": null,
    "hasNext": true,
    "page": 4,
    "pageSize": 20
   },
   "cursorEnd": 6
  },
  {
   "key": "links",
   "label": "Links",
   "about": "href '#results?page={page}': real links with rel prev and next that work without script and open in a new tab on middle-click; a plain click is handled in place because onChange is set. Arrow keys on.",
   "opts": {
    "total": 240,
    "pageSize": 20,
    "page": 5,
    "href": "#results?page={page}",
    "keys": true,
    "siblings": 2
   }
  },
  {
   "key": "german",
   "label": "Deutsch",
   "about": "German words and numbers: 123.456 Ergebnisse, 25 per page, deep in the list.",
   "opts": {
    "locale": "de-DE",
    "total": 123456,
    "pageSize": 25,
    "page": 1234,
    "strings": {
     "label": "Seitennavigation",
     "prev": "Zurück",
     "next": "Weiter",
     "first": "Erste",
     "last": "Letzte",
     "prevLabel": "Vorherige Seite",
     "nextLabel": "Nächste Seite",
     "firstLabel": "Erste Seite",
     "lastLabel": "Letzte Seite",
     "page": "Seite {page}",
     "gap": "Weitere Seiten",
     "range": "{from}–{to} von {total} {results}",
     "rangeOne": "{from} von {total} {results}",
     "rangeOpen": "{from}–{to}",
     "pageOf": "Seite {page} von {count}",
     "pageOnly": "Seite {page}",
     "none": "Keine Ergebnisse",
     "results": {
      "one": "Ergebnis",
      "other": "Ergebnissen"
     },
     "perPage": "Pro Seite",
     "jump": "Gehe zu Seite",
     "go": "Los",
     "errEmpty": "Bitte eine Seitenzahl eingeben.",
     "errNaN": "„{text}“ ist keine Seitenzahl.",
     "errRange": "Wähle eine Seite von {min} bis {count}.",
     "selPage": "Seite",
     "selOf": "von {count}",
     "selLabel": "Seite, von {count}",
     "more": "{n} weitere laden",
     "moreOpen": "Mehr laden",
     "left": "noch {left}",
     "shown": "{shown} von {total} {results} angezeigt",
     "shownOpen": "{shown} {results} angezeigt",
     "done": "Alle {total} {results} angezeigt",
     "doneOpen": "Alle {shown} {results} angezeigt"
    },
    "firstLast": true
   },
   "lang": "de"
  },
  {
   "key": "arabic",
   "label": "العربية",
   "about": "Arabic (Egypt) in a right-to-left frame: Arabic-Indic digits, mirrored arrows, Left goes to the next page with keys on.",
   "opts": {
    "locale": "ar-EG",
    "total": 4321,
    "pageSize": 20,
    "page": 7,
    "strings": {
     "label": "ترقيم الصفحات",
     "prev": "السابق",
     "next": "التالي",
     "first": "الأولى",
     "last": "الأخيرة",
     "prevLabel": "الصفحة السابقة",
     "nextLabel": "الصفحة التالية",
     "firstLabel": "الصفحة الأولى",
     "lastLabel": "الصفحة الأخيرة",
     "page": "الصفحة {page}",
     "gap": "صفحات أخرى",
     "range": "عرض {from}–{to} من {total} {results}",
     "rangeOne": "عرض {from} من {total} {results}",
     "rangeOpen": "عرض {from}–{to}",
     "pageOf": "الصفحة {page} من {count}",
     "pageOnly": "الصفحة {page}",
     "none": "لا توجد نتائج",
     "results": {
      "zero": "نتيجة",
      "one": "نتيجة",
      "two": "نتيجتين",
      "few": "نتائج",
      "many": "نتيجة",
      "other": "نتيجة"
     },
     "perPage": "لكل صفحة",
     "jump": "انتقل إلى الصفحة",
     "go": "انتقال",
     "errEmpty": "اكتب رقم الصفحة.",
     "errNaN": "«{text}» ليس رقم صفحة.",
     "errRange": "اختر صفحة من {min} إلى {count}.",
     "selPage": "الصفحة",
     "selOf": "من {count}",
     "selLabel": "الصفحة، من {count}",
     "more": "تحميل {n} أخرى",
     "moreOpen": "تحميل المزيد",
     "left": "تبقى {left}",
     "shown": "عرض {shown} من {total} {results}",
     "shownOpen": "عرض {shown} {results}",
     "done": "تم عرض كل النتائج ({total})",
     "doneOpen": "تم عرض كل النتائج ({shown})"
    },
    "firstLast": true,
    "keys": true
   },
   "dir": "rtl",
   "lang": "ar"
  },
  {
   "key": "narrow",
   "label": "300 px",
   "about": "A 300 px frame with responsive true: the full control turns compact on its own (ResizeObserver plus a container query).",
   "opts": {
    "total": 1234,
    "pageSize": 20,
    "page": 3,
    "responsive": true
   },
   "width": 300
  },
  {
   "key": "long",
   "label": "Long labels",
   "about": "Long custom words and two siblings each side; the head wraps and the arrows stay put.",
   "opts": {
    "total": 98765,
    "pageSize": 50,
    "page": 400,
    "siblings": 2,
    "strings": {
     "prev": "Previous set of matching documents",
     "next": "Next set of matching documents",
     "prevLabel": "Previous set of matching documents",
     "nextLabel": "Next set of matching documents",
     "range": "Displaying matching documents {from} through {to} out of a grand total of {total} archived {results}",
     "results": {
      "one": "document",
      "other": "documents"
     },
     "perPage": "Documents shown on each page",
     "jump": "Jump straight to page number",
     "go": "Jump there"
    }
   }
  },
  {
   "key": "clamped",
   "label": "Bad input",
   "about": "page 999, pageCount 12.5, pageSize -5 and junk page sizes: clamped to page 12 of 12, size 20. Type 'abc' or 40 in the jump field to see the errors.",
   "opts": {
    "page": 999,
    "pageCount": 12.5,
    "pageSize": -5,
    "pageSizes": [
     0,
     -10,
     "x",
     25
    ],
    "jump": true
   }
  }
 ]
}

entry.name: Pagination
entry.summary: Accessible pagination: a nav landmark with stable-width truncation, range summary in words via Intl, page size, go-to-page with errors in words, compact, simple and load-more variants, cursor mode, real links.
